title: Thai-Style Savory Potato Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Norwegian potato casserole with the bold flavors of Thai cuisine. This savory dish is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with coconut oil.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the sliced potatoes, Thai red curry paste, fish sauce (if using), brown sugar, and soy sauce to the pan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the potatoes start to tenderize.
Transfer the potato mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro.
